verdict.rationale: The release notes record alias moves ("This is now the model behind `gemini-flash-latest`"), which shows that `-latest` aliases track new releases while versioned model IDs stay pinnable. A standing deprecations page tracks dated shutdown floors per model. The alias-to-version policy is shown only through individual changelog entries and summary descriptions, not a dedicated policy statement. missing for 10: an explicit standalone alias/versioning policy document (e.g. stable vs preview vs latest naming rules and alias update notice periods), independent or hands-on corroboration of pinning behavior

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin an exact versioned model ID while aliases track the latest release, with the alias-to-version policy documented

citations.quote: This is now the model behind `gemini-flash-latest`
dated entries for model launches, alias moves, and feature releases
Deprecation announcements are made on the Release notes page, and the announced earliest shutdown dates are tracked on this page.
